name: podcast-ad-tagger

provenance.trained_on: the 1.0 model's training set plus 8,725 episodes of 424 shows outside it (304 chart shows, 120 self-serve shows), machine-labelled
provenance.benchmark: 300 human-labelled episodes: strict F1 0.960 (1.0 model 0.959), missed sponsor 4.8 s/h, sponsor false positives 4.4 s/h (4.9); on shows never seen: false positives 9.0 s/h (12.0) and 8.4 (13.7)
provenance.export: model_dive device/export_onnx.py (torch 2.9.1, opset 17); verified against the PyTorch model to 1e-6, argmax agreement 1.0

inputs.emb: float32 [1, N, 1024]: one unit-length text embedding per transcript segment, in time order
inputs.feats: float32 [1, N, 28]: the raw per-segment features, columns in feature_names order (scaling is built in)

output.probs: float32 [1, N, 5]: per-segment probabilities, columns in classes order

embedder.input: the segment's text with surrounding whitespace trimmed, first 2000 characters, a single space if empty; no instruction prefix

segments: sentence-sized transcript segments, typically 1-10 s and about 10 words (mean 3 s)
